# Code of Conduct

Be respectful and constructive. Critique code and claims, not people.

- No harassment, personal attacks, or discriminatory language.
- Back claims with evidence; this project labels every number MEASURED / EST / UNAVAILABLE and expects the same in issues and PRs.
- Do not post secrets, private transcripts or other people's personal data.

Maintainers may remove comments or block contributors who break these rules. Report concerns by opening a private security advisory on GitHub (Security tab) or an issue marked `conduct`.
